# Baichuan Fire

Quanzhou Baichuan Firefighting Equipment Co., Ltd. supplies fire protection equipment for international distributors, contractors and project buyers.

## Product families
- Fire sprinklers and accessories
- Fire hydrants and accessories
- Fire valves
- Alarm valve systems
- Fire hose reels, hoses and nozzles
- Fire monitors and foam fire-fighting equipment

- Products: https://bcfire119.com/products.html

- Quote request: https://bcfire119.com/contact.html

## Notes
Product-specific specifications, approvals, certificates, pricing, lead times and availability must be confirmed with Baichuan Fire for the exact model and destination market.
